meta.title: TiltKiller trading rules
meta.r_definition: 1R is the amount you risk on a trade (what you lose if the stop hits).

input.slippage_note: Assumption: 0.03% of price on the buy and again on the sell. Change it and every figure recalculates.
input.risk_per_trade_label: Risk per trade (a full stop-out loses this share of the account)

caveats: A big share of the gain comes from a few large winners. HOOD (bought 2025-05-19, about +59 times the amount risked) and MARA (bought 2023-11-27, about +43 times the amount risked) are 32% of the total.
Many months have no trades because the market was in a downtrend, or they lose. Expect long flat stretches between big winners.
The rules were chosen by comparing many rule sets on this same three-year period, so the figures look optimistic.

Not in the headline results or the R figures: late-day sells (the backtest sells at the close), trading costs, how much cash you actually need in the account, and stocks added mid-session. The name list is today’s list, so stocks that later disappeared are missing.
At most 3 new trades a day — so you know your risk up front.
risk_table_intro: $100k start, every trade above, positions overlapping as they did (sized at entry). The reshuffled columns replay the same trades in 2,000 random orders: plan for the 1-in-20 drawdown, not the one history happened to give. Positions together are never more than the account: a new trade is cut to the cash left, or skipped when none is left.

rules_meta.title: TiltKiller trading rules
rules_meta.blurb: 2026-11-16. The rules as the app runs them. Tested over November 2023 to November 2026. Every change is recorded with its full results.

rules.rule: Only trades when the overall market is in an uptrend. If the market looks weak, no new long alerts that day.
Focuses on strong, heavily traded leading stocks — Leaders and Pullbacks.
Buys when a stock turns back up early in the session. Buy alerts land in Discord from the open through 10:45 ET — entry and stop in one message.
Every trade has a set stop. Stops aren’t guaranteed — a gap down overnight or on news can open below your stop.

Alerts for the way in and the way out. Winners are held with a trailing stop, and you get an alert when it’s hit. Losers are cut quickly. No holding through earnings. Max 3 new trades a day. Long trades only.

best_worst_note: R after 0.03% slippage per side (simulation output).
